locations.note: Detective Cole Phelps rises through the LAPD in a meticulously recreated 1947 Los Angeles, with thirty real landmarks to find from Union Station to Grauman's.
Phelps can drive past Union Station and log it as one of the city's landmarks.
The Bradbury Building's iron atrium is among the thirty landmarks of the 1947 city.
Angels Flight still runs up Bunker Hill in the game's 1947, a landmark to find.
Pershing Square, with its wartime lawns, is one of the downtown landmarks.
Grauman's Chinese Theatre anchors the Hollywood cases.
The Central Library's pyramid tower is one of the landmarks on Phelps's beat.
